decks.notes: This Legacy 1 vs 1 Aggro deck, known as Dragon Stompy, focuses on controlling the game by disrupting opponents' strategies. The deck utilizes cards like Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void to lock opponents' lands and spells. The main concept revolves around quickly ramping up mana through cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox and then playing powerful threats like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, Legion Warboss, and Goblin Rabblemaster to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes removal spells like Fury and Unlicensed Hearse to deal with threats. The combination of disruptive elements and aggressive creatures makes this deck formidable.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly generate mana and cards through powerful rituals and cantrips in order to assemble a lethal Storm count and win the game with Tendrils of Agony. The deck utilizes tools like Wishclaw Talisman and Burning Wish to search for key pieces such as Ad Nauseam or Past in Flames to enable explosive turns and outmaneuver opponents. Additionally, the deck includes disruption in the form of Thoughtseize and Duress to protect the combo and Veil of Summer to counter opposing disruption.

This deck aims to disrupt the opponent while applying pressure with efficient creatures and burn spells. By utilizing a combination of countermagic, card selection, and versatile threats like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck seeks to control the tempo of the game and maintain a steady stream of threats. The mana base is streamlined to maximize the deck's consistency and efficiency, allowing for smooth gameplay and powerful plays. With a focus on proactive gameplay and disruptive elements, this deck is designed to win through aggression and resource denial.

This deck focuses on playing low-cost spells and creatures to quickly control the board and put pressure on the opponent. It utilizes cards like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to establish a strong presence while disrupting the opponent with counter spells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also includes efficient card draw with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Expressive Iteration to keep the tempo up. The mana base is optimized for quick and consistent access to the necessary colors of mana, allowing for a fast and aggressive game plan.

This control deck focuses on efficiently controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage engines. It utilizes powerful cards such as Force of Will and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating value over time. By leveraging a mix of blue, white, and green spells, the deck aims to outmaneuver its opponents and slowly grind out a victory. With access to versatile answers like Swords to Plowshares and Supreme Verdict, the deck is equipped to handle a wide range of threats and maintain control of the game.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly and efficiently through cards like Elvish Spirit Guide, Simian Spirit Guide, and rituals to then cast a fast and deadly Belcher activation. The goal is to cast or tutor for Goblin Charbelcher as quickly as possible to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck includes cards like Burning Wish for additional access to combo pieces and Jeska's Will to generate mana and card advantage. The primary win condition is to activate Belcher and hit the opponent for lethal damage in one turn.

This deck relies on the "Show and Tell" combo to quickly put powerful creatures into play. It uses cards like "Sneak Attack" and "Lotus Petal" to cheat creatures like "Griselbrand" and "Emrakul, the Aeons Torn" into play. It also includes counter spells like "Force of Will" and "Flusterstorm" to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's plans. The deck also includes card draw spells like "Brainstorm" and "Ponder" to help find the combo pieces quickly. The mana base consists of various fetch lands, dual lands, and fast mana sources like "Ancient Tomb" to ensure consistent and fast mana production.

This deck aims to deploy threats quickly, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and protect its creatures with countermagic. By playing efficient threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent alongside disruptive elements like Force of Will and Daze, it seeks to control the pace of the game and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and disruption. The inclusion of cards like Delver of Secrets and Lightning Bolt provide additional reach and removal options, ensuring that the deck can adapt to various situations and opponents in the Legacy format.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful creatures like Uro and Endurance. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage with cards like Narset and Sylvan Library. The deck also includes powerful lands like Karakas and Boseiju to further control the game. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to maintain control of the game through a combination of disruption, card advantage, and powerful creatures.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition. The deck includes powerful cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Brainstorm to control the board and protect its key threats. It also utilizes cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Snapcaster Mage for value and card advantage. The mana base includes fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to all colors of mana.

The deck focuses on assembling the Bomberman Combo using Auriok Salvagers and Lion's Eye Diamond to generate infinite mana, then finish the opponent using Walking Ballista or Cut/Ribbons. It also utilizes Urza's Saga to tutor for key artifacts like Chalice of the Void and Lotus Petal, while Karn, the Great Creator can shut down opposing strategies and provide additional utility. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Chalice of the Void and City of Traitors to gain a strategic advantage and secure victory.

The deck revolves around generating mana and card advantage with small elf creatures, while using cards like Glimpse of Nature and Heritage Druid to draw into combo pieces like Craterhoof Behemoth or Regal Force. The deck aims to quickly assemble a lethal board state, often with the help of Green Sun's Zenith or Natural Order to tutor up key creatures. The inclusion of cards like Quirion Ranger and Wirewood Symbiote allows for additional flexibility in mana generation and creature untapping. Ultimately, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a sudden and powerful finish.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with key creatures, such as Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, using cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting. The goal is to then reanimate these powerful creatures onto the battlefield with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead, enabling explosive plays and overwhelming the opponent with huge threats early in the game. The deck also includes disruption cards like Grief and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's hand and ensure the successful execution of the combo.

This deck focuses on deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan to maintain tempo and pressure. By combining efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler with disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will, the deck aims to control the board while quickly closing out the game with burn spells like Lightning Bolt. The deck also utilizes card selection spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistent draws and maximize its chances of success. Additionally, the mana base includes Wasteland and fetch lands to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck also includes efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the board. By efficiently using cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder, as well as cards like Expressive Iteration, the deck aims to maintain card advantage and keep up the pressure on the opponent, all while being able to disrupt their plays with cards like Pyroblast.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal. It aims to control the tempo of the game by using efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Delver of Secrets to apply pressure on the opponent while also protecting its own threats with cards like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also utilizes card advantage with Expressive Iteration and Brainstorm to ensure that it can maintain its momentum and outpace the opponent. It aims to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize and mount a comeback.

The deck aims to control the game by using Cloudpost and Tron lands to ramp up mana quickly, eventually casting powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Endbringer. It also utilizes various artifacts like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere to disrupt opponents' strategies, while Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Ineffable provide additional utility and card advantage. The deck's goal is to overwhelm opponents with large threats and strong control elements, creating a challenging board state for them to navigate.

This control deck focuses on utilizing powerful cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation to disrupt opponent's plays while also generating card advantage with cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes. The deck aims to control the game with efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, while also leveraging powerful threats like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Ice-Fang Coatl. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for the deck to have access to additional resources and value throughout the game.

The deck aims to quickly assemble cards that allow the player to win the game with a single spell. By utilizing efficient card draw, mana acceleration, and disruption, the deck can set up a powerful Doomsday pile that will lead to victory. The deck also includes protection in the form of counterspells and removal to ensure the combo can go off uninterrupted. Thassa's Oracle serves as the win condition once the Doomsday pile is activated, allowing the player to win the game on the spot.

The main focus of this deck is to generate a large number of mana-producing Elf creatures to power out powerful combo pieces like Craterhoof Behemoth and Natural Order. Cards like Glimpse of Nature and Elvish Visionary help draw through the deck quickly while cards like Heritage Druid and Nettle Sentinel help generate mana efficiently. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a large board presence and finish them off with a massive attack from Craterhoof Behemoth or other key combo pieces.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying a swarm of Goblin creatures to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. The key strategy revolves around using cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to accelerate the deployment of powerful Goblin creatures like Goblin Ringleader and Muxus, Goblin Grandee. Utilizing cards like Food Chain and Ignoble Hierarch helps generate the necessary mana to play multiple threats in a single turn. The inclusion of removal spells like Goblin Cratermaker and Fury ensures the deck can handle opposing threats while continuing to apply pressure.

The main strategy of this Legacy Aggro - Initiative Stompy deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing powerful cards like Chalice of the Void, Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, and Archon of Emeria, the deck aims to slow down the opponent while generating value through creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and Seasoned Dungeoneer. The inclusion of powerful equipment like Batterskull and Shadowspear, along with land disruption like Wasteland and Karakas, further enhances the deck's ability to control the game and put pressure on the opponent.

The deck focuses on quickly establishing board presence and disrupting opponents with cards like Chalice of the Void and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben. It utilizes aggressive creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and Solitude to apply pressure and control the game. The inclusion of powerful equipment like Batterskull and Shadowspear enhances the deck's ability to close out games quickly. With a mix of mana acceleration and disruptive creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents while maintaining control of the battlefield.

This Maverick deck focuses on using efficient creatures and targeted removal spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a proactive board presence. By utilizing creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth to slow down opponents, alongside powerful threats like Knight of the Reliquary and Questing Beast, this deck aims to apply pressure and disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck also includes versatile cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Swords to Plowshares to adapt to different situations and maintain control of the battlefield.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's deck, while using Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer to manipulate the graveyard and artifacts. It also includes disruptive cards like Red Elemental Blast and Pyroblast to control the board and protect the combo pieces. The deck aims to efficiently generate mana with cards like Mox Opal and Lotus Petal to play its threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides additional value by tutoring for essential artifacts.

The main concept of this Legacy 1 vs 1 Combo - Painter deck is to use Painter's Servant in combination with Grindstone to mill the opponent's library. It also includes key cards like Goblin Welder, Imperial Recruiter, and Goblin Engineer to search for and recur combo pieces. The deck utilizes powerful disruption cards like Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast to protect the combo and control the opponent's spells. Additionally, the deck includes mana acceleration with cards like Lotus Petal and Mox Opal, along with mana lands like Ancient Tomb and City of Traitors to quickly assemble the combo and win the game.

The deck focuses on quickly getting big creatures into play from the graveyard, using cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead to cheat powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to efficiently reanimate powerful creatures while disrupting the opponent's plans, overwhelming them with threats before they have a chance to respond.

This deck focuses on quickly and efficiently reanimating powerful creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Griselbrand using cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Grief and Thoughtseize while also generating mana with Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual to bring out threats early in the game. With a mix of graveyard recursion and hand disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures before they have a chance to mount a defense.

The main concept of this Show and Tell combo deck is to cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand onto the battlefield early by using cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Simian Spirit Guide. The deck utilizes fast mana in the form of Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb, while also running blue disruptive spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with big threats and win the game before they have a chance to respond effectively.

This UR Tempo deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while disrupting opponents with counter magic like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also utilizes cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm to dig for answers and maintain tempo advantage. Cards like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt provide additional removal and burn spells, while cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help generate card advantage. The deck aims to maintain control of the game by utilizing a mix of disruption and aggressive threats.

This deck focuses on quickly developing threats on the board while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counter spells like Force of Will and Daze. It utilizes efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The deck also incorporates card selection and manipulation spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistent draws and find the necessary answers to deal with opponent threats. Finally, cards like Lightning Bolt and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide additional removal options and further pressure on the opponent.

The key concept of this UR Tempo deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting their game plan using counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and tempo spells like Brazen Borrower, all while maintaining card advantage through cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder. The mana base is designed to support a fast and efficient casting of spells, with a balance between lands that produce colored mana and utility lands like Wasteland and Mystic Sanctuary.
